verdict.rationale: The evidence shows DeepSeek has a real third-party ecosystem. First-party docs name agent tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) that can use DeepSeek as a backend. Community posts show it routed via OpenRouter, and derivative community models like R1-Distill-Llama-8B exist. Missing for 10: curated/awesome-list evidence, proof of active maintainers on third-party tools and integrations, and independent breadth or health metrics for the ecosystem.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the community ecosystem around the model is genuinely alive — curated lists, third-party tools, routers, and integrations with active maintainers

citations.quote: If you use tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or OpenCode, you can use DeepSeek as the backend model directly — no code required.
